text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God,

text_1981: I swear by this town.
text_1989: I solemnly swear by this town.

text_1981: Wherein you reside.
text_1989: The town where you live.

text_1981: By the one that gives birth and the one that is born. (fo We have created the human being to attain a certain accomplishment. O.) Does he think that no one controls him? oT He boasts, “I spent so much money.”
text_1989: The begetting and the begotten.
text_ref: The begetting and the begotten.

text_1981: We created the human being to work hard (to redeem himself).*
footnote_1981: *90:4 See the Introduction and Appendix 7 for the purpose behind our creation.
text_1989: We created the human being to work hard (to redeem himself) *
text_ref: We created the human being to work hard (to redeem himself).*

text_1981: Does he think that no one will ever call him to account?
text_1989: Does he think that no one will ever call him to account?

text_1981: Does he think that no one sees him?

text_1989: Did we not give him two eyes?

text_1981: A tongue and two lips?

text_1989: Did we not show him the two paths?

text_1981: He should choose the formidable path.

text_1981: Do you know what the formidable path is?

text_1981: The freeing of slaves.
text_1989: The freeing of slaves.
text_ref: The freeing of slaves.

text_1981: Or feeding at the time of difficulty.
text_1989: Feeding, during the time of hardship.
text_ref: Feeding, during the time of hardship.

text_1981: An orphan who is related.
text_1989: Orphans who are related.
text_ref: Orphans who are related.

text_1981: Or a poor person who is despondent. 17.
text_1989: Or the poor who is in need.
text_ref: Or the poor who is in need.

text_1981: And being one of those who believe, and exhorting one another to be steadfast, and exhorting one another to be kind.
text_1989: And being one of those who believe, and exhorting one another to be steadfast, and exhorting one a n o th e r to be kind.
text_ref: And being one of those who believe, and exhorting one another to be steadfast, and exhorting one another to be kind.

text_1981: These have deserved happiness.
text_1989: These have deserved happiness.

text_1981: As for those who reject our revelations, they have deserved misery.
text_1989: As for those who disbelieved in our revelations, they have incurred misery.
